That balance keeps things readable for me. In the collection the very long title gets trimmed to a couple of lines and the description to a single line, so one wordy bookmark doesn't blow up into a giant block and push everything else off the screen — my list still scans nicely at a glance. And when I opened Edit, the full title and description were all there, nothing chopped off. So the trimming is just how it's shown in the list, not what's actually stored — the real text is safe and I can read or change all of it whenever I open the item.

That's the right call: tidy list, nothing lost.

I'm happy with that. What's next?
